push.title: W 6-2 vs Drew Peacox FC | You: 9.3
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 9.3. If confidence were contagious, you just gave the whole team a cold.

THE GOOD
+ 4 shots at Drew Peacox FC's goal. That's an attacking mindset.
+ 3 key passes. You threaded the needle and stitched up a chance.
+ Man of the Match, your 13th for us. You led by example, and the example was excellent.
+ That connection with BellyTb1 is gold. Don't let it rust.
+ This result took us into promotion matches in Division 4. That one belongs to all of us, and you were in it.

THE BAD
- 2 of 4 shots on target. Lesson of the day: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger. You've got this.
- Won 0 of 7 tackles (down from your usual 11%). Start here: Win it with your body before your foot: shoulder to shoulder, then poke it away.
- Pass accuracy: 74%. Push for 88%+ and you're elite company.

Kickabout task: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.

PhogsToffees, here's what I'd tell my own kid: Champions are just ordinary folks who kept showing up.

Now go hydrate like a champion. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 6-2 vs Drew Peacox FC | You: 9.1
push.body:
Hot diggity, BellyTb1. A 9.1 against Drew Peacox FC. I didn't know a midfielder could do some of that.

THE GOOD
+ A goal against Drew Peacox FC, your 3rd straight match scoring. Goals are the sweet tea of football, and you poured a glass.
+ 2 assists. Somebody's gonna owe you dinner for those passes.
+ You and PhogsToffees speak the same football language.
+ This result took us into promotion matches in Division 4. Moments like that are why we keep showing up.
+ Won your matchup: 9.1 against their best midfielder's 6.5. That doesn't happen by accident.

THE BAD
- 1 goal from 3 on target. Simple as pie: Pick your spot before the ball arrives, then commit. Changing your mind mid-swing is how shots go wide. Clean it up and fly.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 1. Simple fix: Receive on the half-turn so your first touch can go forward.
- 3 missed tackles: -0.1. Easy upgrade available.
- 5 misplaced passes cost 0.1. Learn and move on.
- 2 goals conceded dropped 0.1. Simple fix.

Tonight's homework: Low shots across the keeper are the hardest to save and the easiest to tap in on the rebound.

BellyTb1, write this on your hand if you have to: Good passes are like good manners. Free, and people remember.

Keep that up and I'll have to start buying bigger biscuit tins. - Coach Lasso
